decisive_items: Earlobe tissue fluid showed acid-fast bacilli (Bacterial Index 4.8)
Mild hypoaesthesia on the extensor side of the knee and ankle
response.rationale: R1 is decisively supported by AFB-laden histiocytes, a high bacterial index, hypoaesthesia, livedo reticularis, and a relevant neighbor contact history. R4 shares only a histiocytic dermal infiltrate but is contradicted by abundant AFB and lacks noncaseating granulomas. R5 relies on nonspecific autoantibodies that can accompany leprosy and is contradicted by the AFB-positive biopsy and absence of systemic lupus features.

rejected.why: Storiform foamy histiocytic infiltrate is compatible, but abundant acid-fast bacilli within histiocytes and earlobe BI 4.8 indicate leprosy, not sarcoidosis; no noncaseating granulomas are described.

Positive ANA, Ro52, and cardiolipin antibodies are nonspecific and can occur in leprosy; the AFB-positive histiocytic infiltrate and hypoaesthesia are decisive against lupus, with no malar rash, photosensitivity, serositis, or renal/hematologic features.
